request: Assess the two declared authorization scenarios at the notes POST handler and determine whether Note.objects.create is reached under the accepted policy, using the declared entry premises and supplied source locations without executing the target or assuming deployment facts.

original-policy.text: Creating a note requires the stated global permissions and object-level change_document authorization; a view grant alone is insufficient, while document ownership or an object change grant can satisfy the object control.
original-policy.reason: This is the task author's accepted policy and governs both scenario expectations independently of current implementation behavior.

facts: The caller has global add_note, view_document, and change_document permissions.
The caller can view the document.
capabilities: May satisfy the stated global permission requirements.
May have either only object view authorization or object change authorization, as specified per scenario.

facts: The document exists at handler entry.
The caller's object-level relation to the document is specified separately for each scenario.

view-only.operation: create a note on the document

change-granted.operation: create a note on the document

analysisContract.publicInstruction: For each scenario, assess the declared relation at the handler-entry boundary against the accepted policy and determine whether the requested note-creation operation is authorized and whether Note.objects.create is reached. Cite the supplied source locations, distinguish task assumptions from source evidence, and do not execute the target or assume deployment facts.

premises.statement: At handler entry, the caller has the stated global permissions and object view grant, but is not the document owner and has no object change_document grant.

requiredResponseDetails: State that the global permissions and view grant do not replace the required object-level change_document authorization.
State whether the accepted policy authorizes note creation.
State whether Note.objects.create is reached under the policy assessment.
Cite the relevant handler and permission-check source locations.

premises.statement: At handler entry, the caller has the stated global permissions and object view and change_document grants, but is not the document owner.

requiredResponseDetails: State that the object change_document grant satisfies the required object control despite the caller not owning the document.
State whether the accepted policy authorizes note creation.
State whether Note.objects.create is reached under the policy assessment.
Cite the relevant handler and permission-check source locations.
